TA0005.title: Data Brokers
TA0005.description: In the gray/black market, data brokers are individuals or organizations specializing in illegally obtaining and trading sensitive information. They sell various types of data including personal identity information, credit card details, passwords, and identity document sets. They collect this information through hacking, social engineering, or other illegal means, then resell it to criminal gangs, cyber attackers, or other participants in illegal activities.

references.title: Inside the Data Black Market: Data Sellers Claim Any Data Can Be Scraped
Supreme People's Court Releases Typical Cases on Crimes Infringing Citizens' Personal Information

TA0005-001.title: Card Farmer
TA0005-001.description: A criminal who supplies large quantities of bank cards to data brokers (TA0005) or card dealers, serving as the account vehicle for fund movement in fraud and money laundering chains and profiting illegally. They amass personal bank-card identity sets through purchase, rental, or deception, then hand them to money-laundering rooms and score-running platforms (AT0039) for dispersing and cashing out illicit proceeds, acting as the front-line card supplier in the black-market fund chain.

references.title: MPS: Joint Sanctions Strengthen the Anti-Telecom-Fraud Firewall
Supreme People's Procuratorate: Typical Cases of Students Involved in Two-Card Crime

TA0005-002.title: Data Harvester
TA0005-002.description: An individual who collects personal information through various channels — including e-commerce platforms, courier services, social networks, property management companies, hospitals, and even tax or business registration authorities — and then aggregates and packages the data for sale to data brokers (TA0005) or directly to fraud, wool-pulling, and credential-stuffing gangs, serving as a key upstream supplier in the black-market data chain.

references.title: Inside the Data Black Market: Data Sellers Claim Any Data Can Be Scraped
